name: oxo-flow-genome-tracks
title: epigen genome_tracks (port)
description: oxo-flow port of the epigen/genome_tracks Snakemake workflow: merge BAM files per group (samtools), compute bigWig coverage (deepTools bamCoverage), plot per-gene genome tracks (gtracks/pyGenomeTracks) and create a UCSC genome browser track hub.
excluded: split_sc_bam — single-cell sinto branch, not on the default path
igv_report — temporarily deactivated upstream (commented out of rule all)
make_bed — only feeds the deactivated igv_report rule
env_export — conda-runtime documentation rule for envs of non-ported branches; envs/ yamls serve the same role
